source: Pew Research Center. 2026. "How the Global Religious Landscape Changed From 2010 to 2020." (dataset updated Feb. 12, 2026 with a Religious Diversity Index.)
method: Percentage-point change in each country/territory's Christian share of population, 2020 minus 2010, from the dataset's own "percentages" worksheet (Level 1 = individual country/territory rows; Level 2 = Pew's six regional rollups; Level 3 = "All World" - only Level 1 rows are used here). Ranked by the ten largest declines (most negative change) across all 201 countries/territories covered by the dataset. Underlying estimates are compiled from more than 2,700 national censuses, demographic surveys, and population registers, not a single Pew-fielded survey.
